t: High performance and long lasting repair tape. Easy to cut and tear by hand and ideal for repair, assembly, covering and protecting projects. Offers maximum bond strength, making it ideal for demanding repairs on transparent surfaces in all weather conditions. Exceptional resistance to vibrations and deformations, as well as UV (without yellowing), frost and temperature, making it a versatile choice for interior and exterior repair projects. Instant adhesion on almost all materials and substrates, rough, smooth and uneven. Waterproof and temperature-resistant from -10 to +75°C.
